info.name: IFQ636 S08 Product API
info.description: Run folders in order with the S08 Local environment. The first request generates new local fixture identities and a password; later requests store local tokens. No credentials are included in this export. This collection does not restart the backend or prove direct DB state; follow s08-postman-test.md for those evidence steps.

item.name: 00 Start a fresh run and create three accounts
01 Publish, read and prove access isolation

exec: if(pm.response.code === 201) { const p = pm.response.json().product; pm.environment.set('productId', p.id); pm.environment.set('productSnapshot', JSON.stringify(p)); }

pm.test('Server owner and active state', () => { const p=pm.response.json().product; pm.expect(p.sellerId).to.eql(pm.environment.get('sellerAId')); pm.expect(p.status).to.eql('active'); pm.expect(p.priceCents).to.eql(2500); });

item.name: 04 Seller A mine contains own Product
05 Seller B mine cannot contain Seller A Product
09 Re-read after denied writes shows unchanged record

body.raw:
{
  "title": "{{runId}} Handmade Ceramic Mug",
  "description": "Handmade ceramic mug for a dedicated S08 verification run.",
  "category": "Ceramics",
  "priceCents": 2500,
  "sellerId": "{{sellerBId}}"
}

item.name: 16 Well-formed missing ID returns not found
17 Re-read proves invalid changes were not saved

exec: pm.test('Owner and creation date retained', () => { const p=pm.response.json().product; const old=JSON.parse(pm.environment.get('productSnapshot')); pm.expect(p.priceCents).to.eql(3000); pm.expect(p.sellerId).to.eql(old.sellerId); pm.expect(p.createdAt).to.eql(old.createdAt); });
